description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the Mqtt3Validator class, testing MQTT connection validation logic such as address syntax, client counts, and enforcement rules.

classes.name: Mqtt3ValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating MQTT connection configurations via Mqtt3Validator.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem before running tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests complete.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the Mqtt3Validator class is immutable.

methods.name: testInvalidSourceAddress
methods.description: Tests invalid MQTT source addresses, expecting exceptions.

methods.name: testInvalidClientCount
methods.description: Checks behavior when an invalid client count is used.

methods.name: testInvalidConsumerCount
methods.description: Checks behavior when an invalid consumer count is used.

methods.name: testInsecureProtocolAndCertificates
methods.description: Validates that insecure protocols and certificates are handled properly.

methods.name: testInvalidTargetAddress
methods.description: Tests invalid target addresses, expecting configuration exceptions.

methods.name: testInvalidHeaderMapping
methods.description: Checks invalid header mappings trigger exceptions.

methods.name: testWithDefaultSource
methods.description: Tests connection with default source configuration.

methods.name: testInvalidSourceTopicFilters
methods.description: Tests invalid MQTT source topic filters.

methods.name: testInvalidEnforcementOrigin
methods.description: Checks invalid enforcement origin leads to exceptions.

methods.name: connectionWithSource
methods.description: Helper to create a connection object with a source address.

methods.name: connectionWithTarget
methods.description: Helper to create a connection object with a target address.

methods.name: verifyConnectionConfigurationInvalidExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Asserts that a ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException is thrown during validation.
